Dearest Kumkum,

From Ishan 💌

Happy National Princess Day to the girl who somehow makes every ordinary day feel like my favorite memory. Whether we're out under the trees, taking silly selfies, or just talking about everything and nothing, being around you is my favorite place to be.

Thank you for your smile, your warmth, your little expressions, and the way you light up every moment we share. You deserve to be celebrated today and every single day—not just as a princess, but as my favorite person in the whole world.

No matter where life takes us, I'm always cheering for you, teasing you a little, and loving you a whole lot. 💖

Forever yours, Ishan 💕
